$comment: KNOWN SQL MANIFEST DEBT - a temporary, explicit, reviewable allowlist.
SqlManifestCompletenessTests fails on any in-scope deployment script that is neither registered in
CrossBuy/deploy/sql/manifest.json nor listed here. This file is what stops that guard from forcing
Stage A to absorb debt it was not authorized to touch - and what stops the debt being forgotten.
EVERY ENTRY IS AN EXACT PATH. No wildcards, no directory prefixes, no patterns: a new script can
never inherit an allowance, which is the whole point. A guard test asserts that too.
class B = a historical deployment script that simply was never registered. Stage B registers these.
class D = two scripts that create the same object with different bytes. Nobody has chosen a winner,
and Stage A was explicitly forbidden to. These need investigation, not registration.
A Class-A script must NEVER appear here: if convergence code needs it, it gets registered.
